# gyro_storage (Resource)

A Gyro Object Storage (S3) or Protected Storage service (region tr-ist-1). Ordered and paid from the account balance (fixed EUR prices, charged in the account currency; renews every cycle from the balance). The first bucket and access key are created automatically; manage buckets and keys with gyro_storage_bucket and gyro_storage_key. List the plans with `gyro storage plans` (GET /cloud/storage/plans); put the service in a project with gyro_service_project. DESTROY DELETES EVERY BUCKET AND OBJECT of the service within minutes (cannot be undone; Protected Storage versions under a COMPLIANCE lock or legal hold stay until the lock ends). Use lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } for data you must keep. plan and cycle never trigger a replacement: changing them is refused.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Object Storage (S3) 1 TB, billed monthly from the account balance
resource "gyro_storage" "yedek" {
  plan  = "standard-1tb"
  cycle = "monthly"
  name  = "gyro-proje-yedek"

  # destroy deletes every bucket and object of the service
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Protected Storage with 2 object lock (WORM) buckets
resource "gyro_storage" "worm" {
  plan                = "protected-250gb"
  cycle               = "annually"
  object_lock_buckets = 2
}

resource "gyro_storage_bucket" "dosyalar" {
  service_id = gyro_storage.yedek.service_id
  name       = "gyro-proje-dosyalar"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan` (String) standard-250gb | standard-1tb | standard-5tb | standard-10tb | protected-250gb | protected-1tb | protected-5tb | protected-10tb.

### Optional

- `cycle` (String) Billing cycle: monthly (default), quarterly, semiannually, annually.
- `delete_immediately` (Boolean) destroy cancels at once and deletes the data (default). false = file a cancellation request instead (the service keeps running until it is processed).
- `name` (String) Service name (nickname, max 60). Changing it renames the service in place.
- `object_lock_buckets` (Number) Protected plans only: object lock (WORM) bucket rights bought with the service (billed every cycle). Set at creation.

### Read-Only

- `due_date` (String) Next renewal date.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) Service id.
- `included_traffic_gb_month` (Number) Outbound traffic included every calendar month.
- `kind` (String) standard or protected.
- `max_buckets` (Number)
- `product_id` (Number)
- `region` (String) S3 region (tr-ist-1).
- `service_id` (Number) Service id (number).
- `size_gb` (Number) Storage quota in GB.
- `status` (String) active, suspended, cancelled...

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_storage.yedek 12345
```
